ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in the Middle East shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.75): the estimate is +0.007 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.033 to +0.047). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
